newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed in thin trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed mixed in markets characterized by lack of interest and thin trading.

Bogota's IBB ended the session with a 0.31 percent gain at 867.31 on a trading volume of 1.38 billion pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index closed a marginal 0.05 percent down at 13,521.18 on a volume of 1.2 billion pesos, brokers said.
The main movers on the Bogota exchange were Banco Ganadero's common shares, up 1.08 percent to 280 pesos each on a trade of 90.9 million pesos.
Banco de Bogota rose 0.42 percent to 5,875 in 9.4 million peso volume, while shares in supermarket chain Cadenalco closed with a 0.32 gain at 935 in volume of 255.96 pesos.
